chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, when he performed wudu (ablution), would say:
In the name of Allah and by Allah; and the best names belong to Allah, and the greatest names belong to Allah, and He is dominant over those in the heaven and dominant over those on the earth.
All praise is due to Allah, who made from water every living thing.

And He revived my heart with faith. O Allah, accept my repentance and purify me, decree for me the best, show me all that I love, and open for me the good things from Your presence, O Hearer of supplication.

key_terms.الْأَسْمَاءِ: the names; referring to Allah’s beautiful and greatest names
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water, from which living things are made
key_terms.بِالْإِيمَانِ: with faith; the means by which the heart is revived
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the name of Allah; the opening invocation

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام recite during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This report preserves a supplication recited by Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام during wudu (ablution). It joins remembrance of Allah’s names and dominion with praise for creation through water, then turns to repentance, purification, faith, and asking for divine good.
